objective: Prevent autonomous intelligence from optimizing the wrong objective, reinforcing existing evidence concentration, drowning in undifferentiated UNKNOWN debt, creating unsafe mutation blast radius, or bypassing truth through partial failure or human override.

controls.problem: Maximum uncertainty reduction is not necessarily maximum decision or business value.
hard_rules: No source priority may be increased solely because it adds record volume.
A source that can move a material claim from NOT_VERIFIED toward defensible evidence may outrank a source that merely reduces many low-impact unknowns.
Decision-impact scoring must remain bounded by evidence and rights admissibility; business value cannot override truth gates.
Missing decision-impact evidence must be explicit rather than guessed.

controls.problem: Strong early evidence in one category or geography can create self-reinforcing acquisition concentration and permanently starve under-covered surfaces.
hard_rules: Reserve a bounded SHADOW exploration quota for under-covered category x geography x evidence-class cells.
Exploration candidates must still pass rights feasibility, provenance and semantic-fit preflight; exploration is not permission to weaken evidence admission.
No incumbent source/category receives priority merely because its prior evidence volume or confidence is high.
Source-owner concentration and category/geography concentration must be measured before each reallocation.
If concentration increases beyond the bounded policy ceiling without proportional decision-value gain, reallocation must HOLD.

controls.problem: A global evidence matrix can produce overwhelming UNKNOWN volume; raw UNKNOWN count is not a useful autonomous priority signal.

classes.definition: Directly blocks Candidate, Track B, a material market claim, empirical gate, or autonomous computability.
Materially limits intelligence depth in a strategically important category, geography or evidence class.
Limits global representation or source-owner diversity but does not immediately block a material decision.
Currently has low decision impact and does not justify displacing higher-value evidence demand.

hard_rules: UNKNOWN remains unknown and never becomes zero.
Raw UNKNOWN count must not drive source priority.
Every weighted debt item must bind category, geography, evidence class, blocked decision/claim if any, and evidence-demand rationale.
Priority may decay or rise only from explicit decision relevance, freshness, evidence gain or dependency change.
A large number of LOW_IMPACT_UNKNOWN items must never swamp a smaller number of CRITICAL_UNKNOWN items.

controls.problem: Once acquisition priority, collection quota or analytical weights become mutable, one wrong autonomous decision can propagate broadly.
fail_closed_conditions: observed outcome diverges materially from expected shadow delta
rollback target or rollback epoch is missing or invalid
drift or contradictory evidence is unresolved

hard_rules: NO_OVERRIDE_OF_RIGHTS_OR_EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_GATES
NO_OVERRIDE_OF_PRODUCTION_OR_G5
OVERRIDE_MUST_BE_SCOPE_BOUNDED
OVERRIDE_MUST_EXPIRE
OVERRIDE_REQUIRES_ROLLBACK_TARGET
OVERRIDE_REQUIRES_IMMUTABLE_AUDIT_DIGEST

non_promotion_rule: These controls improve autonomous safety and decision quality only. They do not create empirical evidence, rights, Candidate, Track B PASS, Projection approval or Production/G5 authorization.
